_meta.indication: Radioactive diagnostic drug indicated for PET myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) under rest or stress (pharmacologic or exercise) in adult patients with known or suspected coronary artery disease (CAD) to evaluate for myocardial ischemia and infarction

pivotal_trials.phase: Adequate and well-controlled multicenter clinical study
pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, single arm, 1-day protocol (rest 2.5-3 mCi i.v.; stress 6-6.5 mCi pharmacologic or 9-9.5 mCi exercise)
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients referred for ICA because of suspected CAD
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: sensitivity and specificity of flurpiridaz F 18 PET MPI in detection of significant CAD as defined by ICA (significant CAD = ≥50% stenosis of ≥1 major coronary artery or major branch)
pivotal_trials.result: Met co-primary endpoints. Sensitivity 77% (72%, 82%), 74% (68%, 79%), 89% (85%, 93%) among 3 readers; specificity 66% (61%, 71%), 70% (65%, 75%), 53% (47%, 58%)

pivotal_trials.phase: Adequate and well-controlled multicenter clinical study
pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, single arm, 1-day protocol; sensitivity/specificity compared to SPECT MPI
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with suspected or known CAD referred for ICA
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Sensitivity and specificity compared to SPECT MPI for detection of significant CAD as defined by ICA or adjudicated history of myocardial infarction
pivotal_trials.result: Did not meet predefined success criteria (flurpiridaz superior to SPECT in sensitivity but noninferiority of specificity not demonstrated). Sensitivity 73% (68%, 78%), 63% (57%, 67%), 77% (72%, 80%); specificity 73% (68%, 77%), 86% (82%, 89%), 66% (62%, 71%)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥2%) during rest and stress PET MPI (N=1,600): dyspnea 17%, headache 15%, angina pectoris 10%, chest pain 8%, fatigue 7%, ST segment changes 6%, flushing 5%, nausea 4%, abdominal pain 4%, dizziness 4%, arrhythmia 4%
target_moa: Flurpiridaz F 18 is an analog of the mitochondrial complex 1 (MC-1) inhibitor pyridaben; it is extracted by the myocardium proportional to blood flow and binds heart tissue with biologically active mitochondria, so radioactivity in viable myocardium is higher than in infarcted tissue
modality: Radiopharmaceutical (fluorine-18 labeled small molecule); positron-emitting radioactive diagnostic drug

rems.type: No risk evaluation and mitigation strategy is needed for this application

companion_dx_detail: Devices and Companion Diagnostic Issues: Not applicable

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting or other external consultation was needed for this NDA

basis.text: Application reviewed under Standard (not priority) review; PDUFA goal date September 27, 2024

summary.text: Flyrcado was submitted as a 505(b)(1) NDA with standard review and approved on the PDUFA goal date, based on two adequate and well-controlled trials; no advisory committee, REMS, or postmarketing requirements were needed.
